name: Thermal Receipt
summary: Pulse prints a running receipt of your product; the feed stalls on the one wrong line and a coral circle lands around it.
look: A warm thermal strip feeds out of a small dark printer onto a deep-teal desk: mono line items, dotted leaders, a zig-zag tear and a black-and-coral two-color print head. One hand-drawn coral loop marks the anomaly.

components.name: Paper strip
components.role: warm white roll with feed lines, curl shading and a zig-zag tear

components.name: Line item
components.role: label · dotted leader · value, 32–34 characters per line

components.name: Two-color head
components.role: black for normal lines, coral for the anomaly

components.name: Dithered header
components.role: one-bit Acme mark plus double-height ACME / PULSE

components.name: Marker circle
components.role: a single hand-drawn coral loop around the line that matters

components.name: Printer body
components.role: dark device with slot and a status LED that turns coral on pause

motion.name: Stepped feed
motion.how: translateY one line per step, steps(1) with 70 ms hold, one line per 16th note at 120 BPM

motion.name: Print-head scan
motion.how: each line reveals with clip-path left → right in 90 ms linear, sounding like the hi-hat

motion.name: Pause & tear
motion.how: feed freezes one full bar on the anomaly; the final tear slides up 20 px and rotates −4° with power3.out over 400 ms on a downbeat

story: Hook: a DASHBOARD CHECK receipt lists SKIPPED over and over, OPEN 38 / CHECKED 3, under 'How many dashboards did you check today?'. Reveal: on the drop the printer bursts a header with the dithered mark and double-height ACME PULSE. Proof: an audit receipt prints OK lines until CHECKOUT −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231 prints in coral, the feed pauses, a circle lands and the human ticks ROLL BACK. CTA: the torn receipt (anomalies 1, customers hit 0) swings aside for 'Caught before customers noticed.' and Start free.
adapt: Print your own checks as line items (tests, sync jobs, invoices, API calls) and let only the failing one print in your accent color; put your key number in the totals block.

fit.risk: a tall strip fights the square frame; crop tight and keep to about 12 lines
